text:
maya: Follow-up from the model-load postmortem. We observed recurring overnight load spikes causing ~3m 503 windows. Need to produce a small runbook + triage scripts and assign owners. Goal: ship edits and scripts within 2 weeks.

maya: Proposed quick actions:
1) Compact playbook edit: explicit escalation ladder (0/2/10 min) + contact matrix. owner: priya. due: 2024-12-08
2) Lightweight triage script `runtime-triage.sh` with health checks, metrics pulls, and logs grab. owner: luke. due: 2024-12-08
3) Fallback routing: add route to warm standby model variant on model-load failure. owner: maya. due: 2024-12-15
4) Cron warmup: k8s CronJob to pre-load models at 23:50 and 02:00. owner: eng-sre. due: 2024-12-08
5) Deploy gate: add small smoke test (5 warms, mean <300ms) to pipeline. owner: priya + eng-sre. due: 2024-12-15

maya: Minimal triage script sketch (one-liners) to include in `runtime-triage.sh`:
# health
curl -fsS https://api.redwood-infer/health || echo "health failed"
# model load metric (p50/p95)
curl -sS "https://metrics/api?query=model_load_latency" | jq .
# recent runtime logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime --tail=250

luke: I'll take the triage script. I will not hardcode tokens; script will prefer METRICS_KEY in env or call `gcloud secrets`. I'll add flags to choose verbose logs vs quick checks.

priya: I'll update the playbook. I want the playbook to include both: a short 'one-click' script for on-call and expanded steps for SREs. Will create `docs/playbooks/model-load-incident.md`.

eng-sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-333. Runbook task epic: RINF-542.

maya: Please reference RINF-542 in your PRs. I will hold playbook PR reviews until triage script and cronjob PRs are linked to the epic.

luke: Quick question 1
1 for the metrics queries: do we want to fetch p50/p95 or include p999? My vote: p50/p95 for quick triage, p99+ for postmortem.

priya: Agree. Keep triage lightweight: p50/p95 + error rate. Add a note in the playbook for when to collect heavier percentiles.

eng-sre-bot: Scheduled tabletop: 2024-12-04 15:00 UTC to walk through the playbook and scripts.

luke: I'll post a first-pass `runtime-triage.sh` as a gist by EOD tomorrow.

priya: I'll open the playbook PR by Monday.

maya: Eng-sre, can you own the CronJob PR? Tag eng-platform if infra changes required.

eng-sre-bot: Reminder: add explicit escalation steps: 0m -> incident channel, 2m -> pager to eng-sre, 10m -> page eng-platform and notify manager. Include emergency phone numbers in the doc.

luke: noted. Also I'll add a `--dry-run` flag to the script to show intended commands without executing.

priya: For deploy gate, we should fail the roll if mean over 5 samples > 300ms or any 5xxs. I'll draft CI snippets.

maya: Thanks. I'll create the JIRA sub-tasks for owners and put deadlines in the epic. After PRs land, we'll run a tabletop with an on-call engineer to validate the ergonomics of the script under page conditions.

oncall-bot: Tabletop run scheduled: 2024-12-06 16:00 UTC.

luke: ":thumbsup:"

priya: ":white_check_mark:"

maya: Closing: keep playbook prescriptive, short primary path first, expanded remediation second. Flag anything that needs automation as a separate ticket.

luke: Roger.
